import re
# Simulating what parse.py does
original = r'[-+]?\d{1,3}(?:[,_]\d{3})*\.\d+|[-+]?\d+\.\d*|[-+]?.?\d+'
s = r'[-+ ]?' + original
print('Full pattern:', s)

tests = ['-.121', '.121', '-12.1', '12.0']
for t in tests:
    m = re.match(s + '$', t)
    print(f'{t!r}: {\"match: \" + m.group() if m else \"no match\"}')
"
